description: This source file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, adding various user interface actions such as selecting gateways, opening settings, navigating pages, completing onboarding, and copying text to the clipboard.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, clears preferred gateway ID, and updates preferences.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to unconfigured, cancels onboarding if running, and clears preferences.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Selects a remote gateway, updates preferences, and assigns the gateway to the current state.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests the specified settings tab, opens the settings menu, and posts a notification.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates to the previous onboarding page with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page or finishes onboarding.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen in user defaults and closes the onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to the system pasteboard and indicates success with a temporary flag.
